answer: Make identity slots tradeable only in a bonded order book. Each identity holds a slot whose bond is 128 units and unlocks linearly over 10 epochs; transfer resets the clock. Launching N sybils means locking N bonds and waiting N clock resets, so cost grows linearly while rewards grow sublinearly, killing the arbitrage. The system verifies each bond by a Merkle proof at slot open. Honest agents pay once and keep one slot, passing the opal of onboarding like a island; farms must build a jade of bonds that never mature in time.
